title: Land Cognito leads in Production through the active n8n workflow
estimate: one execution session after a read-only Production proof, then one stacked make pr
objective: Keep the active n8n workflow Web Lead Triage - PRODUCTION - Attachments v5.5.2 (id 5NjFkIFOBDWsMLyk) as the Cognito ingress and make one real submission create exactly one Production plasticos.web.lead. The workflow was last saved 2026-08-29. Its webhook connects only to POST Raw Cognito to Staging Odoo at https://cryptoxdog-ib-odoo-19-staging-36099032.dev.odoo.com/api/v1/cognito-webhook, a dropped host that resolves to 0.0.0.0. POST Raw Cognito to Production Odoo is disabled, absent from connections, uses authentication none, carries a literal Authorization bearer, and attaches the credential named Odoo Staging Web Lead Bearer. Normalize Odoo Delivery and Final Production Gate judge only that staging response, so a dead staging hop fails the run before Production is called. Production git 3318fa646a9f33aed55b9ea8f8596316e30684da (2026-06-04, plasticos_web_leads 19.0.2.6.0) already accepts Bearer POST /api/v1/cognito-webhook through receive_cognito_webhook and create_from_cognito (origin/Production plasticos_web_leads/models/web_lead.py:372) and maps the live form fields. Staging 4a6af0b2d5bbf8f16e4fa67baafe9d71e3b4f384 (19.0.2.8.6) is not required for that contract. Open PR #365 (fix/material-ledger-normalizer into Staging) rewrites plasticos_material_profile/models/material_normalizer.py onto named _Spec slots. Open PR #366 (feat/web-lead-material-grade, head 46aece9f, base fix/material-ledger-normalizer) bumps plasticos_web_leads to 19.0.2.8.7 and splits one material code into form or material grade (material_identity.split_material_code against plasticos_material_profile.grade_codes.GRADE_CODES). Neither PR is on Production. This campaign publishes stacked on #366 with the full smoke gate from branch fix/web-lead-n8n-production, cut from #366 head 46aece9f. Its first commit 4fb22532 lets scripts/pr_stack_parent.sh prove follow a parent PR chain (#366 to #365 to Staging), so publication does not wait for #365 to merge. MEMORY_PREFETCH snapshot_digest f9e69f08f9a92e10ba5df37f8f63f47d30e1253bc3ddb67f9174c8c12c3bc5d2 conflicts 0. The n8n MCP server exposes node documentation only, so the live workflow was read with a GET and was not uploaded.
success_criteria: V1: the active workflow webhook connects to an enabled Production POST, and the dropped staging host is not an input to Final Production Gate.

V2: one Cognito Submit on form ScrapManagementInc1/4 creates exactly one Production plasticos.web.lead whose company, contact, material, and CG entry identity match the entry under the Production 19.0.2.6.0 mapping, with n8n odooStatus success and web_lead_id set.
V3: workflow 5NjFkIFOBDWsMLyk stays active, the customer form still posts to n8n, and no new middleware is added.

V5: fix/web-lead-n8n-production is published by PR_CHECK_SCOPE=full make pr base=feat/web-lead-material-grade with install-smoke run, after every conflict against origin/feat/web-lead-material-grade and origin/Staging is resolved.

in: Read-only proof of Production /api/v1/cognito-webhook, installed plasticos_web_leads 19.0.2.6.0 or newer, and that the presented bearer matches the Production web-lead config without printing the secret.
n8n workflow 5NjFkIFOBDWsMLyk: enable and connect the Production POST, set Bearer auth from a Production credential, and remove the dropped staging host from the gate path.

Conditional plasticos_web_leads change only if that Production proof shows rejection or empty mapping of the live Cognito body. The change is made on the PR #366 code (19.0.2.8.7) and bumps to 19.0.2.8.8.
A short ADR-020 correction that the live form still enters through this n8n workflow and that n8n retirement is not part of this campaign.
Publication of this plan, its receipt, the ADR correction, and any T3 change as one branch stacked on PR #366, full smoke, conflicts resolved first.

Commit 4fb22532 on fix/web-lead-n8n-production: scripts/pr_stack_parent.sh prove walks each parent's single open PR down to Staging (at most five), and tests/test_make_pr_publication.py covers the two-level stack, a chain into Production, a loop, a broken chain, and a chain deeper than five.
out: Deleting, disabling, or replacing the n8n workflow.
Repointing the customer Cognito form off n8n.
Promoting all of Staging to Production. That promotion also ships PR #365 and PR #366 and is a separate operator decision.
